clips.name: Idle
clips.use: Standing still, slow sway, two head twitches.

clips.name: Count_Start
clips.use: Raises both hands over its eyes.

clips.name: Count_Loop
clips.use: Hands over eyes, nods once per second while it counts.

clips.name: Count_End
clips.use: Hands drop, head snaps up and twitches: ready or not.

clips.name: Walk_Wander
clips.use: Stiff walk while searching, head scans and twitches.

clips.name: Search_Look
clips.use: Stops at a hiding spot, leans in, looks left then right.

clips.name: Spotted
clips.use: Sees a player: jolts upright, head snaps over, points.

clips.name: Run_Chase
clips.use: Sprint with both arms reaching forward.

clips.name: Catch
clips.use: Lunge and grab with a shaking head, for the catch.

clips.name: Head_Twitch
clips.use: Head and neck only, to layer over anything.
